dict.string: OpenAmbi needs microphone access to record ambient sounds for your personal sound library. Your recordings are stored securely and only accessible to you.
OpenAmbi uses your location to tag recordings with place names (e.g., "Beach Waves - Malibu"). Location is only captured when recording and stored privately with your recordings.
OpenAmbi would like to capture photos to accompany your sound recordings.
OpenAmbi would like to access your photo library to select images for your sound recordings.
